messages.body_plain:
Hi

Is there a way to combine the use the confusion matrix and the RISK parameter when I run random forest?

I try to explain with an example.  Let’s say that I have 20 True Positive and all of them has a RISK_Adj of 2 points each and I have 10 False Positive with RISK_Adj 1 points each.  I want to see the sum of all the TP(=40 points) and then the sum of all the FP(=10 points).

How do I do that?

Regards,

Rolf

messages.subject: Re: Export the rows that makes the confusion matrix
messages.subject_clean: Export the rows that makes the confusion matrix
messages.body_plain:
Have a look in the Log tab. The code to generate the matrix is included there.

For the weather dataset, I see the following code used to generate the matrix:

> table(crs$dataset[crs$validate, c(crs$input, crs$target)]$RainTomorrow, crs$pr, dnn=c("Actual", "Predicted"))

Wrap this in a write.csv to save a csv file:

> write.csv(table(crs$dataset[crs$validate, c(crs$input, crs$target)]$RainTomorrow, crs$pr, dnn=c("Actual", "Predicted")), file="tmp.csv")

Is that what you meant?

messages.subject: RStudio and Rattle Plots - rattle 2.6.27 r106
messages.subject_clean: RStudio and Rattle Plots - rattle 2.6.27 r106
messages.body_plain:
The beta version of rattle now displays plots within the RStudio plots pane if rattle is started up from within RStudio.

One advantage is that RStudio maintains a history of plots, making it easy to review all of the plots you've generated over a session. Can also easily export the plots.

Beta version can be installed from Togaware:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

or

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Turn on Advanced Graphics under Settings to generate ggplot2 versions of many plots - still under development so not yet the default option.

Regards,
Graham

messages.subject: Rattle install on R 3.0.1 problem under OSX
messages.subject_clean: Rattle install on R 3.0.1 problem under OSX
messages.body_plain:
This seems to be a common problem.

I cannot install rattle in R 3.0.1 under OSX 10.7.5.

I tried installing an earlier version, R 2.15.0 through R .2.15.3. Some of these earlier R versions would not install so that did not work as a work around for installing R.

Other R packages install without any problems.

I also tried to install rattle under the R console and under terminal prompt. Neither options worked.

Any recommendation on how to solve this?

Details below may help for those who understand the issue better than I.

Thanks, David

Here is the rattleInfo() minus the personal information

> rattleInfo()
Rattle: version 2.6.26 r77 cran 2.6.26
R: version 3.0.1 (2013-05-16) (Revision 62743)

Sysname: Darwin
Release: 11.4.2
Version: Darwin Kernel Version 11.4.2: Thu Aug 23 16:25:48 PDT 2012; root:xnu-1699.32.7~1/RELEASE_X86_64

Installed Dependencies
RGtk2: version 2.20.25
cairoDevice: version 2.19
foreign: version 0.8-54
Matrix: version 1.0-12
nnet: version 7.3-6
randomForest: version 4.6-7
RColorBrewer: version 1.0-5
rpart: version 4.1-1
survival: version 2.37-4

That was 11 packages.
